"I don't lift, I don't want to lose my turn." We hear it every week. 🙅‍♂️

Research comparing the two finds full-range strength training improves flexibility about as much as stretching, and golf studies that added strength and power work have generally seen club speed go up, not down.
✅ Lift through a full, controlled range
✅ Control the lowering phase
❌ Don't cut your range short to move more weight
